purpose: Queue every fret-ui-material3 component for Material outcome alignment, packet evidence, and layer classification.

strategy.escalation_rule: If two or more component rows show the same drift, evaluate a shared Material foundation or kit-policy refactor before duplicating recipe fixes.

waves.focus: Classify the known controls golden drift and audit selector readiness.

Committed value, editable query, floating labels, active indicators, supporting/error text, popup semantics, and picker dialogs.

State layer, ripple, selected indicators, group semantics, gestures, and minimum interactive sizing.
Visual chrome, semantics, gallery evidence, low-interaction goldens, and motion-only split points.
